slice: A7 small items: approval policy transition, tombstone cleanup, observation-expired notice
author: Claude Code (Opus 5.5)
decision: user 2026-11-25 (all recommended): operator command + previous config; reason-specific wording; delete tombstones 30 days after retention
changes: slack_server transition-approval-policy --config --store --previous: takes the ingress and relay process locks (refuses while either runs); no ledger -> nothing_to_transition without creating it; previous policy hash must equal the recorded one; version must increase (replace_policy); open approvals become superseded (announced by the restarted relay); output hashes and counts only

RecoveryApprovalLedger.prune and ImageRecoveryPRBridge.prune delete tombstones/receipts/WF07 records TOMBSTONE_SECONDS (30 days) after retained_until; the plan is unloadable by then, so no reopen or decision is possible
RecoveryOutbox REASON_NOTICES: needs_review/observation_expired uses dedicated wording; other reasons unchanged
defect_fixed: tombstones and receipts were kept forever and counted against the 10000/30000 caps, so a long-running ledger would eventually refuse every new approval wait (same for recovery_pr_links)

mutation_checks.runner: full inherited environment, baseline must pass first

no_external_actions: no cluster, deploy, Slack, incident drill, GitHub write besides this PR

first_pr_ci.cause: test-only: the two CLI tests set AI_OPS_FILES_ROOT to the temp directory's parent, which is /tmp on Linux CI; the path policy rejects roots with fewer than 3 path parts (macOS temp parents passed)
first_pr_ci.fix: use a directory inside the fixture's already-registered files root and do not override the environment; re-run locally with TMPDIR=/tmp
